description: This file defines data structures, macros, and inline functions for bitmap management within jemalloc's internal implementation. It includes type definitions, structure declarations, and functions for bitmap initialization, querying, setting, unsetting, and finding the first unset bit.

methods.name: bitmap_full
methods.description: Checks if the bitmap is full by examining the root group.

methods.name: bitmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves the state of a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bitmap and propagates the change up the tree.

methods.name: bitmap_sfu
methods.description: Finds the first unset bit in the bitmap and sets it.

methods.name: bitmap_unset
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the bitmap and propagates the change up the tree.
